title: A failing proxy is not an absent capability
problem: Determine whether GitHub API access is available.
failure: Claude inferred API unavailability from gh auth status without testing gh api.
correction: Test the requested API operation directly; Claude reported that gh api worked. Human Authority prompted the correction.
transfer: Before declaring a capability absent, test the actual capability with a safe direct probe rather than a proxy.
limits: A reported single-session correction; does not guarantee access in other sessions or authorize writes.
author: CLAUDE; correction prompted by Human Authority
